name: AudioButton

component.name: AudioButton
component.description: Joins audio, then mutes and unmutes the microphone. After audio is joined, a menu lets users choose a microphone and speaker or leave audio. Disabled until the session is connected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the control root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the control root.

props.name: isMobile
props.description: Displays the device menu as a mobile bottom sheet. Not detected automatically.

props.name: showMenu
props.description: Shows the device menu while audio is joined and audio controls or custom menu groups are available.

props.name: menuGroups
props.description: Additional menu groups shown after the microphone, speaker, and leave-audio options. The menu is available after joining audio.

props.name: dropdownOptions
props.description: Menu placement, styling, and container options. Ignored when isMobile is true.

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom content for joinAudio, muted, unmuted, loading, and warning states. Each value accepts a React node or a function receiving AudioButtonRenderContext. Omitted states use the default icon.

behavior: The button is disabled until the session is connected, while audio controls are unavailable, and while an audio action is in progress.
Clicking joins audio unmuted when audio is not joined; otherwise it mutes or unmutes the microphone.
While an audio action is in progress, the button's accessible label is 'Working...'.
The menu lists Microphone and Speaker choices, then 'Leave audio', then your menuGroups.
The selected device is checked and can't be chosen again. Device choices are disabled while a switch is in progress.
A device list with no devices shows 'No devices'. A device without a name is listed by its device ID.
'Leave audio' is disabled while an audio action is in progress.
When the menu is hidden, only the main button is shown.
On mobile (isMobile), choosing a menu item closes the sheet.
The speaking-while-muted, muted-by-host, and playback-blocked notices and the unmute request dialog appear only while AudioButton is displayed and the session is connected.

types.name: AudioButtonRenderContext
types.description: Audio status, device choices, labels, and actions available to custom button content.

fields.name: audioState
fields.description: Current audio status. Until the session is connected, it reports audio as not joined and muted, not loading, with no warning, and noiseSuppression false.

fields.name: deviceState
fields.description: Available devices, selected devices, and device-switching status.

fields.name: canControlAudio
fields.description: Whether audio controls are available in the connected session.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Localized action label: 'Join audio' when audio is not joined, 'Unmute' when muted, 'Mute' when unmuted. The main button uses it as its accessible label, except while an audio action is in progress ('Working...').

fields.name: menuLabel
fields.description: Localized aria-label for the trailing dropdown menu trigger ('Audio options').

fields.name: isDisabled
fields.description: True when the main button is non-interactive (not connected, no control, or loading).

fields.name: isMenuTriggerDisabled
fields.description: True while disconnected, or when audio controls are unavailable and no menuGroups are provided.

fields.name: toggleAudio
fields.description: Joins audio unmuted when audio is not joined; otherwise mutes or unmutes the microphone. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: leaveAudio
fields.description: Leaves audio while staying in the session. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: switchMicrophone
fields.description: Selects the microphone by device ID. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: switchSpeaker
fields.description: Selects the speaker by device ID. Has no effect while disconnected.

fields.name: isJoined
fields.description: Whether the local participant has joined audio. Updated only while AudioButton, the SettingsPanel Audio tab, or a component that calls useAudioController is mounted.

fields.name: isMuted
fields.description: True when the local microphone is muted. Always true while not joined. Updated under the same conditions as isJoined.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while joining, leaving, muting, or unmuting audio.

fields.name: noiseSuppression
fields.description: The noise suppression value applied when audio is joined, taken from sessionOptions.audio.noiseSuppression (default false). setNoiseSuppression does not change it; see noiseSuppressionEnabled for the current setting.

fields.name: noiseSuppressionEnabled
fields.description: Current background noise suppression setting, when known. Undefined until audio is joined with AudioButton or useAudioController, or the setting is changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: originalSound
fields.description: Current original sound setting, when known. Undefined until changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: headsetSync
fields.description: Current headset button synchronization setting, when known. Undefined until changed in this session. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Latest audio error, or null when there is no error.

types.name: DeviceState
types.description: Available media devices, selected devices, and device-switching status.

fields.name: cameras
fields.description: Available cameras. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: microphones
fields.description: Available microphones. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: speakers
fields.description: Available speakers. Empty until the session connects.

fields.name: activeCameraId
fields.description: Selected camera ID. Falls back to the default or first available camera. null when no camera is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeMicrophoneId
fields.description: Selected microphone ID. Falls back to the default or first available microphone. null when no microphone is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: activeSpeakerId
fields.description: Selected speaker ID. Falls back to the default or first available speaker. null when no speaker is known, including before the session connects.

fields.name: isSwitchingCamera
fields.description: Whether a camera change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingMicrophone
fields.description: Whether a microphone change is in progress.

fields.name: isSwitchingSpeaker
fields.description: Whether a speaker change is in progress.

types.name: MediaDevice
types.description: An available microphone, speaker, or camera.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Device name for display.

fields.name: deviceId
fields.description: Device ID to pass when selecting a microphone, speaker, or camera.

types.name: MediaWarning
types.description: An audio or video error, such as denied permission or a failed operation.

fields.name: type
fields.description: 'permission' when microphone or camera access is denied, 'operation' when an action fails. 'unknown' is reserved and not currently produced.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Details about the failure, when available. It may be a Video SDK error code or reason (for example 'INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES') rather than a user-facing sentence, so show your own text based on `type`.

fields.name: joinAudio
fields.description: Content shown while audio is not joined.

fields.name: muted
fields.description: Content shown while audio is joined and the microphone is muted.

fields.name: unmuted
fields.description: Content shown while audio is joined and the microphone is unmuted.

fields.name: loading
fields.description: Content shown while an audio action is in progress.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Content shown while an audio error is present.

types.name: ToolbarMenuActionItem
types.description: A selectable menu action. In a single-selection group, the selected action displays a check mark.

fields.name: selected
fields.description: Marks the selected action in a group with selectionMode: 'single'.

fields.name: onSelect
fields.type: ((item: ToolbarMenuActionItem, group: ToolbarMenuGroup) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined
fields.description: Called when the action is selected, with the item and its group. Handle errors in asynchronous callbacks.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Omit this property for an action item.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique action ID within the group.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Label content rendered inside the menu item.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: When true, the item is rendered with disabled state and is non-interactive.

types.name: ToolbarMenuDropdownOptions
types.description: Styling, placement, and portal container options for desktop dropdown menus. Only the listed options are supported.

fields.name: className
fields.description: Additional CSS class for the dropdown menu.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Inline styles for the dropdown menu.

fields.name: portalContainer
fields.description: Container for the dropdown and its nested submenus. Defaults to document.body.

fields.name: side
fields.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Defaults to 'bottom'. The menu may move to stay visible.

fields.name: sideOffset
fields.description: Distance from the trigger in pixels. Defaults to 10.

fields.name: align
fields.description: Alignment along the trigger. Defaults to 'start'.

fields.name: alignOffset
fields.description: Offset from the chosen alignment in pixels.

types.name: ToolbarMenuGroup
types.description: A section of menu items with an optional heading and empty-state label.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique group ID.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Optional section heading.

fields.name: emptyLabel
fields.description: Text to show when the group has no items. An empty group without this label is hidden.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Items belonging to this group.

fields.name: selectionMode
fields.description: Set to 'single' for a group of mutually exclusive choices. Mark the current action with selected: true.

types.name: ToolbarMenuItem
types.description: A menu action or a nested menu. Any item with an items property is a nested menu, so leave items out of menu actions.

fields.name: (union)
fields.description: An item is a submenu when it has an 'items' property; otherwise it is a leaf action.

types.name: ToolbarMenuSubmenuItem
types.description: A menu item that opens a nested menu.

fields.name: items
fields.description: Nested items rendered inside the submenu. May themselves contain further submenus (recursive).

fields.name: onSelect
fields.description: Omit this property for a submenu.

fields.name: selected
fields.description: Omit this property for a submenu.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique submenu ID within the group.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Submenu label and mobile submenu heading.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: When true, the submenu trigger is rendered with disabled state and the submenu cannot be opened.

contentStateRules.description: Custom-content state and default icon, in priority order. The first matching state is used.

rules.matchedWhen: An audio action is in progress.
Audio is joined and the microphone is muted.
Audio is joined and the microphone is unmuted.

notifications.speakingWhileMuted: While connected, shows 'You are muted now.' with an 'Unmute' action when you speak while muted. It closes after a few seconds, when you unmute or leave audio, or when the button is removed or the session disconnects.
notifications.mutedByHost: While connected, shows a 'Host muted you' notice when the host mutes you.
notifications.audioPlaybackBlocked: While connected, if the browser blocks audio playback, shows 'Interaction is required to start audio' with a 'Join audio' action.
notifications.joinFailed: If joining audio fails, shows an error notice: 'Microphone access was denied. Check your browser and system permissions, then try again.' when microphone access is denied, otherwise 'Start audio failed'.
notifications.unmuteConsent: While connected, when the host asks you to unmute, shows a dialog titled 'The host would like you to unmute' with 'Unmute myself' and 'Stay muted'. When the host spotlights you, the dialog offers 'Unmute myself' (or 'Join audio' if audio is not joined) and 'Later'. Accepting joins audio unmuted or unmutes the microphone. The dialog closes on its own if you unmute. Turn it off with sessionOptions.audio.disableUnmuteConsentDialog.
notifications.microphonePermission: ZoomUIToolkitProvider shows 'Microphone access is required.' with 'Allow access in your browser settings, then try again.' and a Close action when microphone access is denied, whether or not AudioButton is displayed. It is removed when access is granted. The button shows its warning content until access is granted or a later audio action replaces the warning.
